title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-16
content:
Morning:
- 09:00 sync with Eng (serving-runtime) — follow up on quantization perf regression on 7B model. Action: Carlos to run perf suite and share logs by EOD.
- 10:00 call with Sales (Acme Corp) — prepare Dedicated cost estimate + latency SLO examples.
- 11:30 skip-level with Eve — quick alignment on launch comms and docs scope.

PRD edits (today):
- Rolled out updated "rollout policy" section: canary -> 50% -> 100% with auto-fallback. Need to attach rollback playbook (SRE).
- Add concrete examples for model-variant routing (latency-first vs cost-first). Placeholder snippets added, need eng review.
- TODO: insert sequence-length distribution chart (ask Data for sample of 10k requests) — JIRA-4521.
- Shorten the intro to be more buyer-focused (move technical details to appendix/runbook).

Launch checklist (internal beta - hosted API v0.9):
- [ ] Finalize public docs page + quickstart (assign to Eve)
- [ ] Add monitoring alerts: 95th pct latency per model, error-rate spike, kv-cache hit rate
- [ ] Confirm Dedicated capacity baseline config + burst policy (ops)
- [ ] QA streaming + function-calling flows end-to-end (test flows: chat streaming, embedding + rerank)
- [ ] Legal: DPA sign-off for launch (waiting on Legal)
- [ ] Add canary metric dashboard (per-route latency + cost)

Stakeholder follow-ups:
- PMM: need final launch copy by EOD Thu (ask for subject lines + CTA options)
- Sales Eng: send latency benchmark table + draft quote for Acme (Carlos)
- Solutions Eng: quickstart template for Private deployment + network prep checklist (linked runbook CONFLUENCE-PLATFORM-186)
- SRE: runbook for canary rollback + obs playbook (priority)

Open questions / decisions:
- Default prefix caching: enable by default? Risk: may mask downstream model regressions. Proposal: off by default for first 2 weeks of beta.
- Quantization tradeoff: small-batch token cost increase ~3% on pico workloads; confirm numbers and include in weekly metrics.
- Autoscale burst policy for Dedicated: how to bill bursts vs baseline (finance input needed).

Notes to self:
- Keep PRD minimal; link to runbook instead of repeating ops steps.
- Add a short section with a few "rollback sentences" that non-eng stakeholders can read.
- Remind Legal to escalate DPA if we want to onboard Acme next week.

Quick links & tickets:
- JIRA-4521 (rollout + metrics)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/432 (console rollout UI)
- CONFLUENCE-PLATFORM-186 (private deploy runbook)

Actions for today:
- Ping Data for sequence-length sample (Samir)
- Draft canary rollback playbook outline and share with SRE (by 3pm)
- Send benchmark table to Sales Eng (Carlos)
- Update PRD appendix with links to runbooks and add the new metric names

End of notes.
